# AdFunnl

> AdFunnl is a marketing analytics and ad reporting platform for agencies, media buyers and performance marketers. It connects ad accounts on Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Google with store revenue from Shopify, converts everything into one reporting currency, and shows it in one live dashboard that can be shared with clients as a view-only link or a PDF.

AdFunnl is a web app at https://app.adfunnl.com, operated by Funnl Suite LLC in Alexandria, Egypt. The app and this site are available in English and Arabic. There is a free plan, and paid plans are priced in USD and EGP.

## What it does

- Connect: Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Google Ads, plus Shopify, Bosta and Google Sheets import. Coming next: Salla, Zid and Easy Orders stores, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics and HubSpot. Data syncs on a schedule set by the plan, from every 12 hours down to hourly.
- Visualize: a freeform drag-and-drop dashboard builder with KPI tiles, charts, tables, funnels, geo maps and creative galleries. Blended ROAS, spend, purchases and revenue across platforms, product-level ROAS from store data, and comparison against the prior period.
- Creative analysis: ads ranked by a composite score (Best Creatives), ad fatigue tracking, and hook and hold video retention on Meta.
- Pulse: watches accounts against rules you set and flags them Scale, Hold or Cut.
- Share: live view-only links, frozen report snapshots, PDF export, the client's logo on their dashboard, and a Looker Studio connector.
- Ask: an in-app AI assistant that answers questions about the data and can build a dashboard after you approve its plan, plus an MCP server so Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP client can query the same data.
- Ad control: from Claude or ChatGPT, change ads after approving each change in the chat. Pause, turn on and change budgets on Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Google. Duplicate, rename, delete and edit audiences, ad text and URL tags on all four. Launch new campaigns and add new ads on Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Google (Google: Search, Shopping, Display, Demand Gen and Performance Max, videos from YouTube; plus keywords and search terms). Create audiences on Meta, TikTok and Snapchat, and website-visitor lists on Google; Anything new starts paused, and every change is written to the brand's Change Log. TikTok and Snapchat are live, Meta and Google are in beta. Included in Growth and Agency, a Solo add-on otherwise, not part of the free trial.

- [AI ad control](https://www.adfunnl.com/ai-ad-control): run your ads from Claude or ChatGPT, with what it can change on each platform
- [For Account Managers](https://www.adfunnl.com/for/account-managers): client reporting
- [For Team Leads](https://www.adfunnl.com/for/team-leads): overseeing many accounts
- [For Media Buyers](https://www.adfunnl.com/for/media-buyers): daily analysis and creative ranking

- [Security](https://www.adfunnl.com/security): how workspace data is protected
- [Blog](https://www.adfunnl.com/blog): guides for media buyers and performance marketers

## Guides

- [How to calculate blended ROAS across every ad platform](https://www.adfunnl.com/blog/how-to-calculate-blended-roas): the formula, why averaging platform ROAS or adding up platform revenue gives the wrong number, platform revenue against store revenue, a worked example in EGP, SAR and USD, and which exchange rate to use
